_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Summer Bean Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: White beans, tomatoes, carrots, red onion, garlic, spinach, and herbs simmered together and finished with a bright touch of lemon.

items.name: Summer Garden Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Crisp romaine topped with fresh tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and feta, served with a house vinaigrette.

items.name: Chicken Pesto Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Herb-roasted chicken, crisp bacon, melted provolone, and house-made garden basil pesto on our house bread, pressed golden and crisp.
notes: Served with pickle and Featured Side

items.name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Potatoes
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Baby potatoes roasted with garlic, Parmesan, and Italian herbs until golden and tender.

items.name: Peach & Raspberry Cake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Tender sour cream cake baked with fresh peaches and raspberries and finished with a light lemon glaze.
